name: Yearly ZCTA-Level Counts
description: Yearly mortality and demographic summaries at the ZCTA level, including beneficiary counts, death counts, and age, sex, race, and dual enrollment distributions.

content.year: Int64: Calendar year of the data
content.dual_pct: Double: Percentage of dual-eligible beneficiaries (Medicare & Medicaid)
content.hmo_pct: Double: Percentage enrolled in HMO plans
content.buyin_pct: Double: Percentage with state buy-in coverage
content.disability_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with original Medicare entitlement due to disability
content.race_rti_unknown_pct: Double: Percentage of beneficiaries with unknown race (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_white_pct: Double: Percentage of Non-Hispanic White beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_black_pct: Double: Percentage of Non-Hispanic Black beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_other_pct: Double: Percentage of Other race beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_asian_pct: Double: Percentage of Non-Hispanic Asian beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_hispanic_pct: Double: Percentage of Hispanic beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_ai_an_pct: Double: Percentage of Non-Hispanic American Indian/Alaska Native beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
